title: Export/share use healed highlight thickness
description:
Hiding fat ghost lines in Plan View was not enough for Share: that path serves the baked PDF bytes, which could still hold oversized ink from the zoom bug. Download already cleared and reburned from the overlay, so it was mostly fine.

Now bake/export stroke helpers sanitize thickness, healed plans queue a one-shot Save Highlights rebake into storage, and Share auto-saves dirty highlights before creating the link.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync. If you see Save Highlights, click it once (or Share) so the PDF bytes match the normal line width.
changeLog: Sanitize stroke width when baking/burning PDF ink annotations.
Queue one-shot rebake after stroke heal so storage PDFs lose fat ink.
Share waits for dirty highlight save before serving raw annotated PDF.
